walkthroughs.body_html:
HL Regional Option: History of Africa & the Middle East — a core area of History.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

HL Regional Option: History of Africa & the Middle East brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with HL Regional Option: History of Africa & the Middle East.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Why did Stalin blockade West Berlin in 1948?
options: Stalin blockaded Berlin to stop Nazis escaping to the West.
Stalin blockaded Berlin because he wanted to invade Western Europe.
To force the Western Allies out of Berlin in response to the merging of their zones, introduction of the Deutschmark, and creation of a separate West German state.
The Provisional Government fell because the Tsar returned and reclaimed his throne.
